EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a very strong 1006 cm⁻¹ band characteristic of the pyridine/benzene ring-breathing mode (noted near 1008 cm⁻¹ for pyridine), a strong aromatic C=C/C=N stretch at 1599 cm⁻¹, and a prominent carbonyl at 1700 cm⁻¹ consistent with an aromatic ester. The strong 1242 cm⁻¹ band matches an ester C–O stretch, and CH stretches at 3074 cm⁻¹ (aromatic) plus 2955/2988 cm⁻¹ (alkyl O–CH₃) are present (support: GFQ-003). Absence of aldehydic CH (~2720–2830) disfavors 10; absence of NH stretches (~3300) disfavors 6; lack of OH evidence disfavors 5. Overall, COC(=O)c1ccccn1 best fits the observed pattern.
